projects.title: Bluebell Residence
projects.summary: A landmark high-rise residential development in Al Aamra, Ajman, combining modern urban living with architectural elegance.
description: Set in the rapidly developing community of Al Aamra, Ajman, Bluebell Residence is a contemporary high-rise residential development designed to provide modern urban living with exceptional comfort, functionality, and architectural elegance. Developed for GJ Properties, the project reflects a commitment to quality construction, efficient planning, and an enhanced residential lifestyle.

The development features a striking modern façade with a balanced composition of glass, textured cladding, and warm neutral finishes that create a distinctive identity within Ajman's growing skyline. The podium incorporates an elegant architectural screen, providing both aesthetic appeal and practical shading while accommodating ample parking facilities.

Currently under construction, Bluebell Residence has been thoughtfully planned to meet the demands of today's residents by combining spacious living environments with premium amenities. The project consists of a Ground Floor, six podium parking levels, twenty typical residential floors, a dedicated health club floor, and a roof level, offering residents a complete and convenient lifestyle within a single integrated development.

projects.title: One 678
projects.summary: An ultra-tall organic tower in Aamra, Ajman, with a fluid, wave-like silhouette of continuous wraparound balconies.
description: This tower is located in Aamra, Ajman. The building features a striking, contemporary organic design characterized by a dynamic, fluid silhouette. The tower's form relies on a rhythmic, undulating pattern that mimics natural wave formations, giving the ultra-tall structure a sense of movement and lightness.

The main body of the tower is defined by continuous, wraparound balconies. Each floor plate's slab edge shifts slightly or curves uniquely, creating a highly textured, self-shading facade. This sinuous rhythm breaks up the massive vertical surface, softening the tower's footprint against the skyline.

The lower levels form a distinct rectangular base that anchors the tower to its corner plot, using a crisp, geometric language with alternating horizontal bands that transition the scale from the streetscape to the massive tower above.

The prominent wave-like projecting balconies feature a smooth, matte white architectural concrete finish, maximizing sunlight reflection and providing a stark, clean contrast to the recessed elements.

The building integrates modern residential living with active retail frontage, complemented by a central courtyard pool and a gym overlooking the water-inspired amenity space. Designed to blend comfort, lifestyle, and refined coastal aesthetics, the development contributes a modern landmark presence within the growing Al Zorah community.

projects.title: Star Giga Tower
projects.summary: A fluid, ribbon-balconied residential tower in Emirates City with a louvered podium and rooftop amenity deck.
description: This tower is located in Emirates City, Aamra, Ajman, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. The tower features a striking, fluid exterior characterized by continuous undulating, ribbon-like balconies. The slab edges curve smoothly inward and outward, shifting slightly across the floors to create a dynamic, ocean-wave or ripple effect across the entire surface.

The podium uses a dense, rhythmic screen composed of vertical and horizontal architectural louvers, creating a textured, semi-permeable skin that cleverly conceals the internal parking levels while allowing natural ventilation.

Sitting directly atop the 6th podium level, the elevation steps back slightly to introduce a prominent horizontal band of lush landscaping. The crest of the elevation features prominent, illuminated "Star Giga" branding with a star emblem, acting as a glowing architectural landmark visible from a distance against the twilight sky.
The building includes retail stores and rooftop amenities including a swimming pool, gym, sauna, yoga deck and walking track.

description: Zamzam Tower is a G+6P+15F+Health Club+Helipad residential building in Global City, Aalia, Ajman, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, developed for Zam Zam Brothers with an expected completion of 2029.

The building exhibits a contemporary, high-contrast urban design that balances strong vertical geometry with soft, rounded corner elements. The lower levels form a massive, grounding podium clad in dark, vertical textures, punctuated by sharp, full-height vertical gold fins that visually anchor the tower and draw the eye upward. The ground floor is dedicated to pedestrian-friendly retail spaces with continuous glazing.

The most defining architectural feature is the prominent, semi-circular glazed bay on the corner, running continuously up the entire height of the building — softening the sharp edges of the intersection and acting as a transparent, glowing beacon.

The building terminates with an elegant, curved canopy and parapet finished in a signature mustard-yellow, echoing the rounded corner of the tower and framing the illuminated "Zamzam Tower" signage on the roof parapet walls.
